summary: The public v0 CLI must live in an internal module directory whose Go module path does not end in /v0.
reason: Go semantic import versioning reserves trailing /vN suffixes for major versions and rejects explicit /v0 or /v1 suffixes, so direct and npm-driven go install must resolve through a neutral directory such as library/ai/vzero while preserving the public v0 slug and binary names.
validated_outcome: go list ./cmd/v0-pp-cli resolves the package under module github.com/mvanhorn/printing-press-library/library/ai/vzero.
